explanation: This is gRPC's standard Apache-2.0 text, followed by BSD-3-Clause (Google 2016) for the named Objective-C podspec files and the unchanged MPL-2.0 text for etc/roots.pem. The MPL-2.0 part is the standard license text and is not marked 'Incompatible With Secondary Licenses', so every license in the file is allowed.
